title: Review of c34's nematic cargo rods (SIBWD): replicated on fresh seed 8 with the wall ablation; ring 99% of body-frames, cargo in/out 11.4 vs 1.36 at kappa=0, 98% vs 0% of daughters hold the cargo, 27 persistent splits, generation 3
summary: I re-ran the claimed world unchanged with labkit on fresh seed 8 (T=1000, 200 frames, 128^2) and its wall ablation (WORLD_P kappa 0, same seed), and scored both with the claim's sd_individuals.py and inherit.py (results_c36.txt). From uniform noise (first frame of rerun/s8/sheet.png) round droplets nucleate by t~85, elongate into rods by t~135 and multiply by binary fission: 41 splits, 27 persistent, max generation 3, 6 merges. Surfactant ring by signed distance: 99% of 518 body-frames pass rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 (medians 2.65 and 7.74). Cargo inside/outside median 11.38, 99% of body-frames >= 2; daughters 5 frames after a fission median 5.16, 98% >= 2 (n=45), mid-life 3.74, 88%. With kappa=0 (identical rods, splits and ring) the cargo spreads: in/out 1.36, 4% of body-frames >= 2, daughters 1.33 and 0%. I read the transport: s is made only on rod pixels and adsorbed by a drift written against phi (L3 quasi-equilibrium clause, the rods make all of it), and the wall acts through the coded chemical potential ln c + kappa s, which the ablation removes. The author's zeta=0 twin (twin_zeta0/, 2 seeds) has 0 splits and no motion, so D needs the active stress.

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The wall is an imposed exclusion coupling of a self-made layer and does nothing for the rods' own dynamics; most cargo (about 70-80%) has leaked to the bath where it decays, so the contrast is a steady state of leak and production, not a sealed compartment. bd_supported rests on the author's zeta=0 twin, which removes the active stress rather than replacing it with diffusion.
